page_title: MAI 1-1 EIN | Mainz v Eintracht Frankfurt 04/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in a cross from the corner, but Kevin Trapp reads it well and gathers the ball.
90+4' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' Neat link-up play between Kaishu Sano (Mainz) and Nelson Weiper, but Kevin Trapp reads the game well and the move breaks down.
90+3' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hugo Ekitike walks off the pitch to be replaced by Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+1' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+1' A pass from Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Nelson Weiper rounds off a good move with a layoff to Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
89' Martin Petersen blows his whistle as Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
88' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
86' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
85' Here comes a substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Nathaniel Brown.
85' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
82' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies high over the bar.
82' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Paul Nebel (Mainz) offside.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) will replace Jae-Sung Lee.
81' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) replaces Phillipp Mwene.
81' Substitution. Hyun-Seok Hong (Mainz) replaces Anthony Caci.
80' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
79' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Rasmus Kristensen try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
77' Stefan Bell (Mainz) rises high to meet a perfect corner kick and heads from the edge of the box towards the right post, but it isn't strong enough and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
77' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
76' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul during an attacking move.
75' Martin Petersen blows his whistle after Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Eintracht Frankfurt.
74' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt).
74' Substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya walks off the pitch and Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
72' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
72' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kaishu Sano (Mainz).
71' The total number of attempts is 7:6. The shots on goal statistics – 2:2.
70' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
69' CHANCE! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Arthur Theate.
69' The attendance for today's match is 33000.
68' Hugo Ekitike is picked out by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
65' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
64' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
63' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and signals a foul after Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Eintracht Frankfurt.
63' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

61' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
60' Stefan Bell (Mainz) picks out Jae-Sung Lee with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
60' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
57' 1 - 1 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gets on the end of a delightful cross and sends the ball inside the right post!
56' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
53' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
52' Stefan Bell (Mainz) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
50' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
47' Poor challenge! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is penalised for tripping and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
46' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball in, but Lasse Riess comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+10' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+10' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Martin Petersen blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45+7' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
45+7' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a rebound after a melee on the edge of the box. His first-time shot is poor, though, and curls well wide of the right post.
45+6' Celebrations are cut short for Mainz as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
45+4' Attention! Referee Martin Petersen straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
45+4' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
45+3' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:1.
45+2' A rebound falls to Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar.
45+2' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

45+2' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt can continue in their attacking effort.
45+1' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
44' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
38' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
38' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
37' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
36' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

34' Nadiem Amiri whips in the corner and finds Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just over the bar from close in. He should have scored!
34' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is about to take a corner kick.

34' Chance! Paul Nebel sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Stefan Bell (Mainz), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
34' The corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
33' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
32' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.

30' Paul Nebel (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Mainz win a corner kick.
25' Bo Henriksen is forced to make a change. Danny da Costa is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
24' Danny da Costa (Mainz) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
24' Total attempts – 0:2. 0:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
20' A long through ball into the box almost gives Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
18' Martin Petersen blows his whistle and it's Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

16' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt). Hugo Ekitike plays a fantastic through ball and finds Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
15' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Hugo Ekitike was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
14' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Anthony Caci (Mainz). Mainz will take a corner kick.
10' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is substituted due to injury. Bo Henriksen gives a chance to Stefan Bell.
10' It doesn’t look good for Dominik Kohr (Mainz); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
8' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
5' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
3' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) commits a foul and Martin Petersen immediately signals a free kick.
1' Lasse Riess pulls off a great save to deny Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Martin Petersen is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
